Fig. 8, 10, 11 (article, raster): marker centres / bar tops / error-bar caps located on the embedded native rasters (xref 57: 1114×540 px; xref 69: 2320×1719 px, 1-bit; xref 70: 581×492 px) and mapped through the tick marks; overlapped markers are flagged row by row. Details and self-checks in the header of digitized.csv.
